DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("procdump.exe", "procdump64.exe",
                      "rundll32.exe", "taskmgr.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has "lsass"
   or (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
       and ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs.dll"
       and ProcessCommandLine has "MiniDump")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in (KnownEdrServiceAccounts)
